body: theorem empty {A : Type} (n : Nat) : scan (n+1) ([] : List (Option A)) = (0, none) := rfl
theorem accepted {A : Type} (n : Nat) (a : A) (xs : List (Option A)) : scan (n+1) (some a :: xs) = (1, some a) := rfl
theorem rejected {A : Type} (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) : scan (n+1) (none :: xs) = ((scan n xs).1+1, (scan n xs).2) := rfl

theorem consumed_le_cap {A : Type} (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) : (scan n xs).1 ≤ n := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => simp [scan]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp [scan]
    | cons x xs => cases x <;> simp [scan]; exact ih xs

theorem consumed_le_length {A : Type} (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) : (scan n xs).1 ≤ xs.length := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => simp [scan]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp [scan]
    | cons x xs => cases x <;> simp [scan]; exact ih xs

theorem scan_map {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    scan n (xs.map (Option.map f)) = ((scan n xs).1, (scan n xs).2.map f) := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs => cases x <;> simp [scan, ih]

theorem count_map {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    (scan n (xs.map (Option.map f))).1 = (scan n xs).1 := by rw [scan_map]

theorem status_map {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    (scan n (xs.map (Option.map f))).2.isSome = (scan n xs).2.isSome := by
  rw [scan_map]; cases (scan n xs).2 <;> rfl

def trace {A : Type} (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) : Nat × Bool :=
  ((scan n xs).1, (scan n xs).2.isSome)
theorem trace_relabel {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    trace n (xs.map (Option.map f)) = trace n xs := by
  simp only [trace, count_map, status_map]

theorem same_flags {A B : Type} (n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) (ys : List (Option B))
    (h : flags xs = flags ys) : trace n xs = trace n ys := by
  rw [coins_only n xs, coins_only n ys, h]

theorem rejected_prefix {A : Type} (r n : Nat) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    scan (r+n) (List.replicate r none ++ xs) =
      (r + (scan n xs).1, (scan n xs).2) := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Nat.succ_add, List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, rejected, ih]
    simp only [Nat.succ_add, Nat.add_succ]

theorem first_accept {A : Type} (r n : Nat) (a : A) (xs : List (Option A)) :
    scan (r+n+1) (List.replicate r none ++ some a :: xs) = (r+1, some a) := by
  rw [show r+n+1=r+(n+1) by omega, rejected_prefix, accepted]

theorem exhausted {A : Type} (n : Nat) :
    scan n (List.replicate n (none : Option A)) = (n, none) := by
  have h := rejected_prefix (A := A) n 0 []
  simpa [scan] using h

theorem accept_in_range (p x : Nat) (h : x < p) :
    (if x < p then some x else none) = some x := if_pos h

theorem reject_at_boundary (p : Nat) :
    (if p < p then some p else none : Option Nat) = none := by simp
theorem geometric_zero (q : ℚ) : geom q 0 = 1-q := by simp [geom]

namespace PV_L2B_SamplerLaw
-- IID path weights, not an axiom identifying SHA outputs with IID words.
def geom (q : ℚ) (r : Nat) : ℚ := q^r * (1-q)
def success (q : ℚ) : Nat → ℚ
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => (1-q)+q*success q n
def valueMass (q u : ℚ) : Nat → ℚ
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => u+q*valueMass q u n
def prefixMass (q u : ℚ) (r : Nat) : ℚ := q^r*u
end PV_L2B_SamplerLaw

body: theorem geometric_step (q : ℚ) (r : Nat) : geom q (r+1) = q*geom q r := by simp [geom,pow_succ]; ring
theorem success_zero (q : ℚ) : success q 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem success_closed (q : ℚ) (n : Nat) : success q n = 1-q^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [success]
  | succ n ih => rw [success, ih, pow_succ]; ring
theorem total_capped (q : ℚ) (n : Nat) : success q n + q^n = 1 := by rw [success_closed]; ring

theorem value_factor (q u : ℚ) (n : Nat) (p : ℚ) (h : u*p=1-q) : valueMass q u n * p = success q n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [valueMass,success]
  | succ n ih => simp only [valueMass,success]; calc
      (u+q*valueMass q u n)*p = u*p+q*(valueMass q u n*p) := by ring
      _ = (1-q)+q*success q n := by rw [h,ih]

theorem uniform_on_success (q u p : ℚ) (n : Nat) (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : u*p=1-q) : valueMass q u n = success q n / p := by
  apply (eq_div_iff hp).2; exact value_factor q u n p h

theorem prefix_independent (q u p : ℚ) (r : Nat) (h : u*p=1-q) : prefixMass q u r * p = geom q r := by
  unfold prefixMass geom; calc q^r*u*p = q^r*(u*p) := by ring
  _ = q^r*(1-q) := by rw [h]

theorem prefix_uniform (q u p : ℚ) (r : Nat) (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : u*p=1-q) : prefixMass q u r = geom q r / p := by
  apply (eq_div_iff hp).2; exact prefix_independent q u p r h
theorem scalar_normalization (p : ℚ) (hp : p+1 ≠ 0) : (1/(p+1))*p = 1-1/(p+1) := by field_simp; ring

theorem scalar_trace_law (p : ℚ) (hp : p+1 ≠ 0) (r : Nat) : prefixMass (1/(p+1)) (1/(p+1)) r*p = geom (1/(p+1)) r :=
  prefix_independent _ _ _ _ (scalar_normalization p hp)

theorem scalar_uniform (p : ℚ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p+1 ≠ 0) (n : Nat) : valueMass (1/(p+1)) (1/(p+1)) n = (1-(1/(p+1))^n)/p := by
  rw [uniform_on_success _ _ _ _ hp (scalar_normalization p hp1), success_closed]

theorem scalar_prefix_product (p : ℚ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p+1 ≠ 0) (r : Nat) : prefixMass (1/(p+1)) (1/(p+1)) r = geom (1/(p+1)) r * (1/p) := by
  rw [prefix_uniform _ _ _ _ hp (scalar_normalization p hp1)]; ring
theorem entropy_reject_partition (z : ℚ) : z + (1-z)*z = 1-(1-z)^2 := by ring
theorem entropy_accept_partition (z : ℚ) : z+(1-z)*z+(1-z)^2=1 := by ring
theorem entropy_pair_normalization (b : ℚ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : (1/b^2)*(b-1)^2 = 1-(1-(1-1/b)^2) := by field_simp; ring

theorem entropy_uniform_pair (b : ℚ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hn : (b-1)^2 ≠ 0) (n : Nat) :
  valueMass (1-(1-1/b)^2) (1/b^2) n = success (1-(1-1/b)^2) n / (b-1)^2 :=
  uniform_on_success _ _ _ _ hn (entropy_pair_normalization b hb)

theorem entropy_prefix_pair (b : ℚ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hn : (b-1)^2 ≠ 0) (r : Nat) :
  prefixMass (1-(1-1/b)^2) (1/b^2) r = geom (1-(1-1/b)^2) r / (b-1)^2 :=
  prefix_uniform _ _ _ _ hn (entropy_pair_normalization b hb)

theorem geometric_nonnegative (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (r : Nat) : 0 ≤ geom q r :=
  mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hq1)
theorem exhaustion_nonnegative (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (n : Nat) : 0 ≤ q^n := pow_nonneg hq n

  rw [div_pow, one_pow, ← pow_mul]

-- Per successful 64-byte fill: 0=first zero (second check skipped),
-- 1=second zero, 2=both nonzero. OS error schedule is a separate input.
def kind {A B : Type} : Option A × Option B → Nat
 | (none, _) => 0
 | (some _, none) => 1
 | (some _, some _) => 2
def checks (kind : Nat) : Nat := if kind=0 then 1 else 2
def branches {A B : Type} : Nat → List (Option A × Option B) → List Nat
 | 0, _ => []
 | _+1, [] => []
 | n+1, x::xs => if kind x=2 then [2] else kind x :: branches n xs
end PV_L2B_EntropyTrace

    kind (p.1.map f,p.2.map g)=kind p := by
  rcases p with ⟨a,b⟩; cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl

theorem branches_relabel {A B C D : Type} (f : A → C) (g : B → D)

  induction n generalizing xs with

    cases xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs => simp only [List.map_cons,branches,kind_relabel,ih]

      ((branches n xs).map checks).sum := by rw [branches_relabel]
